sections_en.text: Maintenance Steps to be Carried Out.

rows: Clean the cell with the air blower.
Disconnect terminals (a2, 3) from the back of the relay.
Connect the two leads of the Severker 650 injection set to points (2, 3) on the relay from the back.

Connect the Stop leads from the Severker 650 injection set to terminals (4, 5) on the relay from the back (note: connect point 5 to the positive point, red in colour, on the Severker 650 injection set, and connect point 4 to the negative point, blue in colour, on the Severker 650 injection set, without disconnecting terminals (4, 5) on the relay from the back).
Set the injection current value to a2 x Setting Value.
Set the selector on the Severker injection set to No. Contact.
Reset the time meter display on the Severker 650 injection set.
Set the Severker 650 injection set operating switch to (ON Time).
Record the relay operating time corresponding to the current value a2xSetting Value (note that the Severker injection set disconnects automatically after the relay operates).
Lower the current value to zero, then disconnect the Severker 650 injection set.
Reconnect terminals (2, 3) on the relay from the back.
Remove the plastic cover from the front of the relay.
Fasten the plastic cover on the front of the relay.
Reset the lockout relay on the cell and confirm this by hearing the relay sound and by the CB Trip indicator lamp going out.

Maintenance Steps to be Carried Out.
Clean the cell with the air blower. | 1.

Connect the two leads of the Severker 650 injection set to points (2, 3) on the relay from the back. | 3.
Connect the Stop leads from the Severker 650 injection set to terminals (4, 5) on the relay from the back (note: connect point 5 to the positive point, red in colour, on the Severker 650 injection set, and connect point 4 to the negative point, blue in colour, on the Severker 650 injection set, without disconnecting terminals (4, 5) on the relay from the back). | 4.
Set the injection current value to a2 x Setting Value. | 5.
Disconnect the Severker 650 injection set. | 6.
Set the selector on the Severker injection set to No. Contact. | 7.
Reset the time meter display on the Severker 650 injection set. | 8.
Set the Severker 650 injection set operating switch to (ON Time). | 9.
Record the relay operating time corresponding to the current value a2xSetting Value (note that the Severker injection set disconnects automatically after the relay operates). | 10.
Lower the current value to zero, then disconnect the Severker 650 injection set. | 11.
Reconnect terminals (2, 3) on the relay from the back. | 12.
Remove the plastic cover from the front of the relay. | 13.
Reset the relay. | 14.
Fasten the plastic cover on the front of the relay. | 15.
Reset the lockout relay on the cell and confirm this by hearing the relay sound and by the CB Trip indicator lamp going out. | 16.
